teaser: A room goes quiet when an 11 walks in. A thought dissolves before the INTP in you can pin it down. Life path 11 carries an intensity that arrives before explanation; INTP wiring wants to take that intensity apart and find the mechanism underneath. The crossing is a particular kind of friction: a sense of something vast, caught by a mind that only trusts what it can verify. What shows up in a week is not mysticism and not pure logic, but someone standing in a hallway, feeling the whole conversation before anyone has said a word, already asking why it feels that way.
